scope: Secondary predeclared low-complexity diagnostic; not a replacement for the primary GRU-versus-bag gate.
preprocess: log1p, StandardScaler fit only on fit role
threshold: clean calibration BAcc over 0.01:0.99, closest to 0.5 then lower tie rule
selection: No feature selection; all eight fixed statistics used
interpretation: Strong performance would motivate studying representation/distribution effects before increasing temporal memory complexity. It would not establish a new method or explain a specific neural detector.
